# Fixtures

`moby-dick-opening.txt` — the opening chapters of *Moby-Dick* (Herman Melville, 1851),
from Project Gutenberg's ebook #2701, which is in the public domain in the United States.
The Project Gutenberg header and licence text are not included, so nothing here carries
their trademark terms; this is the novel's own text.

It is here because the English front end's coverage claim — *99 % of a book's words
without a G2P model* — has to be measured against a real book, and the owner's library
cannot be checked into a public repository.
